PM Modi Highlights Technology's Social Reach at Bloomberg Forum

Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum, emphasizing the theme 'Power to Empower' and highlighting the wider social reach of technology, data, and innovation. He stressed how technology can be used to empower individuals and communities.
